# gov5 profile-1 vectors V3, V4 and V5 (byte-exact copies)

Copied unchanged from `/data/blockchain/wr-logs/qs-scratch/profile1/vectors/` on 2026-11-24
(gov5 branch feat/profile1-tx, generated by gov5's `TestProfile1VectorV3` / `TestProfile1VectorV4`).
V3: QMDB write sets and roots of seven blocks on the standard genesis; V4: transaction validity.
Both run on the standard genesis, whose execution-relevant fields (chain id, forks, alloc,
reward, faucet, gas limit) equal V1's `genesis_8s.json`
(`crates/n42/qmdb-reth/testdata/profile1/gov5/V1/genesis_8s.json`); only slot values differ.
Byte-exact contracts: compare by SHA-256 of the raw bytes, never edit. Checked by
`n42_engine_types::profile1_vectors` (`v3_*`, `v4_*`).

V5 (republished for AM25) copied unchanged from the same directory on 2026-11-25: gov5 branch
feat/profile1 at 590d9673 ("docs(profile1): document the V5 EIP-8282 builder request case") or
later; the three files are byte-identical to `internal/testdata/profile1/vectors/V5/` at 590d9673
and at feat/profile1 6a3e1eb9. Generated by gov5's `TestProfile1VectorV5`
(`header_validity.json`: eight sealed blocks, requestsHash deferred under AM25) and
`TestProfile1VectorV5BuilderRequestContracts` (`builder_request_contracts.json`: EIP-8282 code,
no call on a native chain). The vector directory carries no SHA-256 manifest; the hashes below
were taken from the copied bytes. Checked by `crates/n42-node/tests/profile1_deferred.rs` (V5
chain) and `crates/n42-node/tests/profile1_vectors.rs` (`v5_builder_request_contracts_*`).
